subtitles.en: What happens when this sort of case-shaped economy gets very entrenched? I think you see it in many economies on the world, but it seems like it's more pronounced in China.
subtitles.zh: 当这种K型经济变得根深蒂固时会发生什么？我认为这在全球许多经济体中都能看到，但在中国似乎更为明显。

subtitles.en: I don't know if you feel that way, but what happens when you rely on just one sector to really feel growth now?
subtitles.zh: 我不知道你是否也有同感，但当你现在只依赖一个行业来拉动增长时，会发生什么？

subtitles.en: I think in the short run, just like the correspondent mentioned, people do expect in the third quarter, there will be some physical and monetary easing on the way, because, for example, in the first half of this year, government bond issuance has been, local government bond issuance has been slowing down, and also that's part of the reason that's why fixed asset investment has been slowing down.
subtitles.zh: 我认为短期内，正如记者提到的，人们确实预期三季度会有一些财政和货币宽松政策出台，因为例如今年上半年，政府债券发行、地方政府债券发行一直在放缓，这也是固定资产投资放缓的部分原因。
en_highlights: bond issuance has been slowing down

subtitles.en: But we will see something in Q3 or Q4. If growth continues to beat below expectations. But in the longer period, I see it's more on the income distribution, and also social security net issue, if you try to boost consumer confidence and consumer demand.
subtitles.zh: 但三季度或四季度我们会看到一些动作，如果增长继续低于预期的话。但长期来看，我认为更重要的是收入分配和社会保障网问题，如果你想提振消费者信心和消费需求。

subtitles.en: For example, we continue to increase or improve the social safety net. There's still one sort of rural workers that doesn't have enough coverage, for example, house insurance, social securities. Once you increase the social safety net, that people can be able to spend.
subtitles.zh: 例如，我们继续加强或完善社会保障体系。仍有一类农民工群体保障不足，比如住房保险、社会保障等。一旦加强社会保障网，人们才敢消费。

subtitles.en: Yeah, I think it's the same issue for China and the US, AI monetization. It's just in different magnitudes, for example, the US AI firms spend a lot of money in terms of CAPACs, maybe a smaller scale by the Chinese firms, but they were facing the same issue, like how to convert this huge AI investment into earnings, which is AI monetization.
subtitles.zh: 是的，我认为中美两国在AI变现方面面临同样的问题，只是规模不同。例如，美国AI公司在资本支出上投入巨大，中国公司规模可能较小，但他们都面临同样的问题，即如何将巨额AI投入转化为盈利，这就是AI变现。

subtitles.en: because for most analysts, they also try to expect higher earning growth for these firms. So I think it's the same question for both Chinese and the US firms. It's just different scale.
subtitles.zh: 因为大多数分析师也预期这些公司会有更高的盈利增长。所以我认为中美企业面临同样的问题，只是规模不同。

clips.speaker: Wang Shengzhu
clips.title: 地产拖累经济：政策还在等，需求何时修复？

subtitles.en: I think China's economic data in July has been below expectation across the board.
subtitles.zh: 我认为7月份的经济数据全面低于预期。

subtitles.en: But to me, this is more structural rather than cyclical, because we see the largest drag is still the housing market.
subtitles.zh: 但在我看来，这更多是结构性问题而非周期性问题，因为最大的拖累仍是地产市场。

subtitles.en: And we see that the new house starts and house sales are still in a deeper recession.
subtitles.zh: 我们看到新屋开工和住宅成交仍处于较深的调整中。

subtitles.en: And also, including, for example, consumer demand, vehicle sales. Vehicle and housing are the two largest single expenditure items for any household, similar even in the US.
subtitles.zh: 同时，消费需求、汽车销售也偏弱。汽车和住房是家庭最大的两项支出，美国也是如此。

subtitles.en: So this is reflect some weak consumer demand, but to me it's more on the over-investment in the housing market in the previous years, and also the housing market itself is developing and also resulting in a weak consumer demand.
subtitles.zh: 这反映了消费需求偏弱，但更多是前些年地产市场过度建设所致，地产市场自身调整也拖累了消费需求。

subtitles.en: And on the other side, that's some over-capacity, over-supply issue, causing the deflation has been lasting so long.
subtitles.zh: 另一方面，存在产能过剩和供给过剩问题，导致价格下行持续较久。

subtitles.en: So to me, the policy makers, they are in a relatively wait-and-see or muddling-through mode.
subtitles.zh: 所以在我看来，政策制定者处于相对观望或边走边看的状态。

subtitles.en: As long as the growth, like Yvonne mentioned, as long as the growth can maintain at the lower end for this year, say, 4.5%.
subtitles.zh: 只要增长能维持在今年目标区间的下限，比如4.5%左右。

subtitles.en: They don't want a very drastic stimulus package, given that they also acknowledge it's more structural issue, and rather than cyclical components of it.
subtitles.zh: 他们不希望推出过于激进的刺激方案，因为他们也认识到这更多是结构性问题，而非周期性问题。

subtitles.en: Export is the most notable and also I would say the derivatives as you said it related to AI development because those models are not necessary for export right but they also benefit.

subtitles.en: I think those are the highlights but I think it's a little bit risky to call education because you have a very narrow kind of.

subtitles.en: A very strong arm of the key exactly the arm is actually pretty thin right then the leg is extremely long and thick.

subtitles.en: And at the moment I think that we're still seeing predominantly the gross deceleration in most sectors.

data_driven_lessons.source: KC桌面-视频号动态数据明细.csv, 114 rows, July 2026 local analysis
winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突
avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
纯描述式标题，例如 某市场短期风险与长期催化剂，缺少问题和冲突
经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
把事实换成疑问号但没有反差，例如 回报路径在哪、未来如何、能否实现
陌生英文人名或机构全称占据第一行，却没有告诉观众这个人为什么值得听
把 Bloomberg LP 等来源或公司法律后缀误当成采访对象
没有公开证据却暗示嘉宾撒谎、操纵或言行不一
